name: Jackson Hole Airport

runway.v: one runway, 01/19, 6,300 ft x 150 ft (about 1,920 m x 46 m); field elevation 6,451 ft; the FAA diagram warns of runway excursion risk from density altitude and runway length

curfew.v: voluntary curfew: all aircraft are asked not to land or take off 21:30-07:00 local, except emergency medical flights and approved irregular airline operations; it cannot be legally enforced but operators get a violation letter and a lower Fly Quiet score
curfew.quote: All aircraft are requested not to land or takeoff after 9:30 pm or before 7:00 am local time.

noise.v: mandatory: only aircraft certified Stage III may operate, Stage 2 aircraft may not land, and no aircraft whose single-event noise level on approach exceeds 92 dBA; no flights below 3,000 ft AGL over Grand Teton National Park; runway 01 is the preferred arrival and runway 19 the preferred departure runway
noise.quote: operation is limited to aircraft certified as Stage III.

deicing.v: de-icing on pads off the movement area; crews must know their provider's de-icing frequency and call Ground 124.550 before taxiing from the pads
deicing.quote: Aircraft must leave the movement area to access the pads.

handling.v: the airport refers general aviation to Jackson Hole Flight Services

notes: Runway from the FAA airport diagram AL-504 for the current d-TPP cycle 26 Nov-24 Dec 2026.
